subject: MAP: Integration scope & auth questions
messages:
From: Megan Liu <megan.liu@acmefinancials.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 17:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP kickoff: integration checkpoints & auth questions

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — the team and I are excited about the performance profile and the streaming options. Per our kickoff, I'll be owning the MAP on the Acme side and wanted to capture a few integration-specific questions before our weekly check-in: 

- Auth: our security team prefers an OAuth2 client-credentials flow with token rotation; can Redwood support short-lived tokens being pushed via a customer-managed KMS/HSM?
- SDKs: we plan to use the Java SDK for server-side calls and a light JS client for browser SDK calls. Any known gaps with streaming + function/tool-calling in the JS path?
- Tool calling: we have an internal ticketing tool we want Redwood to call for incident creation — is webhook-based tool calling appropriate, or should we surface a connector?

I'll attach a short requirements doc and the MAP spreadsheet we sketched. Can you confirm owners on your side for: SDK lead, Auth lead, Streaming lead, and a primary for tool-calling?

We'd like to aim for a vendor evaluation close within the next 6 weeks if possible — the MAP has a couple of gating tasks (SOC2 artifact review, performance runbook).

Thanks,
Megan Liu
Integration Program Manager
Acme Financials

Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: integration checkpoints & auth questions

Hi Megan — great to hear and thanks for the clear list. I pulled together a quick owner map and initial answers; attaching an updated MAP (MAP-v3.xlsx) and a short auth pattern diagram.

Quick answers up front:
- Auth: yes — Redwood Private supports customer-managed KMS and short-lived tokens. For your workflow we recommend using our token broker pattern + mutual TLS for the token exchange; Karthik will lead on the HSM integration.
- SDKs: JS streaming currently supports function/tool-calling in hosted and dedicated modes; we'll validate browser LT storage for KV cache (edge-case). Monica will run a short validation with your JS use-case.
- Tool calling: webhook connector is the simplest initial route; if you need more robust two-way sync we can scope a connector. Camila will own the tool-calling prototype.

Owners (Redwood):
- SDK lead: Monica Patel (monica_patel) — JS + Java validation
- Auth lead: Karthik Iyer (karthik_iyer) — KMS/HSM + token broker
- Streaming lead: Rishi Malhotra (rishi_malhotra) — streaming SLOs and KV cache
- Tool-calling: Camila Reyes (camila_reyes) — webhook/connector prototype

Proposed next steps (action items):
1) Redwood to run a short JS streaming validation (Monica) — due 2026-11-09
2) Auth pattern call to align on token rotation and KMS access (Karthik + Acme sec) — schedule this week
3) Tool-calling prototype kickoff (Camila) — deliver POC by 2026-11-17
4) Performance runbook draft for eval (Rishi) — initial draft 2026-11-12

I'll set up a 30-min sync later this week; Megan, does Thu 11/6 10:00 PT work for you?

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Partner Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com

Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 11:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: integration checkpoints & auth questions

Folks — quick internal note after scanning Acme's reqs PDF. A couple of immediate blockers/assumptions for the JS streaming validation: 

- Browser token storage: Acme prefers short-lived tokens; we should avoid storing refresh tokens client-side. We'll use a temporary session token pattern and validate the session handoff.
- CORS + SSE fallback: their browser environment uses strict CSP; I want to confirm whether SSE is acceptable or if we need to fallback to websockets.
- SDK versioning: we should test with our latest JS alpha (v1.8.0-alpha) — there are streaming fixes not in stable.

I'll start the validation run against their sample app; Monica -> test plan: 
- 2 day smoke test (stream + function-calls) against dedicated staging
- 4 token rotation scenarios (short TTL, token revocation, rotated KMS keys, clock skew)

I'll update the MAP spreadsheet with these tasks and owners.

-Monica
Senior SDK Engineer, Redwood
